retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic, low-light interior scene featuring two figures in a state of distress or contemplation, characterized by a heavy green color cast and localized red lamp light.
excludeWhen: the mood should be cheerful or energetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format photograph capturing a dimly lit, textured interior. One man sits on a patterned bed in the foreground, head in hand, while another stands in the background on a landline telephone. The scene is dominated by a sickly green ambient light, contrasted sharply by a warm red glow from a small bedside lamp.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground figure in shadow vs. background figure in light
Sickly green ambient wash vs. localized red lamp glow
Horizontal bed texture vs. vertical wall and doorframe lines
Isolation of characters within a shared cramped space
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and soft focus
Strong green color cast in shadows and midtones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is seated in the lower center-left foreground, occupying roughly 40% of the frame. The secondary subject stands in the upper right background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red bedside lamp acts as the central chromatic anchor, drawing the eye to the middle of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright red lamp, moves left to the slumped figure on the bed, then follows the telephone cord up to the standing figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows on the far left create a sense of void and claustrophobia.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated, sickly green (ambient light and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant crimson red (lamp shade and localized glow)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall value with high saturation in the red accent; green is mid-saturation and muddy.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to muddy greens, deep reds, and blacks

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square-format cinematic photo of a 1970s motel room. A man in a dark suit sits on a green patterned bedspread, head in hands. In the background, another man in a tan jacket uses a vintage beige wall phone. The room is lit by a sickly green overhead light and a single small bedside lamp with a bright red shade. Use heavy film grain and soft focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, sans-serif font in a muted off-white color. Position it in the dark negative space on the left or centered at the bottom with high tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the green color cast dominant?
Is there a distinct red glow from a lamp?
Does the image look like it was shot on 35mm film?

mustRedesign: Digital sharpness or lack of grain
postGenerationChecks: Ensure red lamp is the primary color accent
Check for visible film grain and slight blur
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Motel Melancholy = (Square Format + 1970s Interior) * (Green Ambient Wash + Red Lamp Accent) / (Heavy Film Grain + Soft Focus)
